rules.title: Rear-yard fence height
rules.detail: Rear-yard fences may not exceed 6 feet and must use cedar, composite, or wrought iron.

rules.title: Setback
rules.detail: Fence must remain at least 3 feet behind the front plane of the home.

rules.title: Neighbor acknowledgment
rules.detail: Adjacent owners must acknowledge receipt when the project touches a shared property line.

rules.title: Site plan
rules.detail: Applications must include a labeled site plan with dimensions and material notes.

rules.title: Drainage plan
rules.detail: Hardscape over 120 square feet requires a drainage sketch.

rules.title: Conduit routing
rules.detail: Exterior conduit must be painted to match the adjacent surface.
